hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -q '\.md$' && npx prettier --write "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -q '\.go$' && gofmt -w "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true

input=$(cat); active=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false'); if [ "$active" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; proj=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // ""'); [ -z "$proj" ] && proj="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; if ! cd "$proj/backend" 2>/dev/null; then jq -cn --arg p "$proj/backend" '{"decision":"block","reason":("golangci-lint hook misconfigured: cannot cd into "+$p)}'; exit 0; fi; result=$($HOME/.goenv/shims/golangci-lint run ./... 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && [ $rc -ne 5 ]; then jq -cn --arg m "$result" '{"decision":"block","reason":("golangci-lint failed:
